# Kirian Luna — Ingeniero en Sistemas / Systems Engineer

> Kirian Luna (kirian.dev) is a software engineer from Limón, Costa Rica, on the Caribbean coast, building modern digital products where engineering, design, and user experience come together. He holds a degree in Systems Engineering from Universidad Latina de Costa Rica and is pursuing further studies in Software Engineering and Teaching. He crafts scalable, performant, intuitive, and visually refined digital experiences.

## Core Information
- **Name**: Kirian Luna
- **Role**: Ingeniero en Sistemas / Systems Engineer
- **Location**: Costa Rica (UTC-6 / CST)
- **Website**: https://kirian.dev
- **Languages**: English, Spanish

## Technical Expertise & Stack
- **Frontend Development**: TypeScript, React 19, Next.js (App Router), Astro, TailwindCSS, Web Audio API, Framer Motion.
- **Backend Engineering**: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, RESTful APIs, JWT Authentication, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
- **Design & User Experience**: Systems Design, SXO (Search eXperience Optimization), Responsive Micro-animations, Web Accessibility.

## Featured Projects
1. **LEBP Academic System**: Enterprise full-stack system built for Liceo Experimental Bilingüe Pococí (LEBP). Centralizes student administration, enrollment, real-time attendance with email notifications, grade management, and audit logs using Next.js 15, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Prisma.
2. **Puerto Limón**: Interactive digital platform preserving Costa Rica's Caribbean cultural identity, archival photographs, and location mapping.
3. **Young Legends**: Modern landing page built for streetwear and athletic lifestyle branding.
4. **UMP Music**: Web platform featuring custom Web Audio API interactions and streaming player components.
